name: This is a Plaza (Madrid, Spain)
content: Purpose and Problem Lavapiés is a neighborhood where there are no green spaces, where neither children nor adults can play due to the lack of parks and playgrounds, where different cultures and religions are not related due to the mistrust generated by ignorance of the other. That is why the project wants to create a public space that is comfortable and where recreational, cultural, educational and environmental activities can be developed, which help interaction and, therefore, better understanding of the neighbors with whom the neighborhood is shared, but with those who generally do not coexist. The purpose of the project is to facilitate the processes of active citizenship, through the active and conscious participation of neighbors in the management of public spaces in the neighborhood.HistoryThe project was born from the workshop “Mounting of urban actions” organized by La Casa Encendida and the Urbanaccion de Madrid group, with the collaboration of the Esterni de Milan association (December 1 to 5). This workshop consisted of transforming a site, closed for more than 30 years (C / Doctor Fourquet no 24), into a public space open to all residents of Lavapiés through a quick and inexpensive intervention. The group "Operarios del Espacio Público" began the workshop with a series of interviews with the inhabitants of the neighborhood, through which we clearly detected the lack of a green space in Lavapiés. Therefore, the action was articulated in the realization of a large green square, called “Esta Es Una Plaza”, where the neighbors could meet, play sports, play, organize cultural events, grow vegetables, exchange time and objects, etc. .. Originating Entities and Financing Neighborhood self-management project of the urban plot of Calle Doctor Fourquet no 24 Public Space Operators: Andre Albuquerque - architect Cristina Braschi - architect Jerome Gottardi - architect Laura Riera - environmental sciences Nuria Navarro - biologist Olga de Marco - industrial designer Remedios Vincent - fine arts Roberta de Nanni - architect We have 270 signatures of support from the neighbors collected during the opening event of “Esta Es Una Plaza”. Selection of Participants All the residents of the neighborhood and all the people who want a new public space in Madrid. Methods and Tools Used Neighborhood self-management of the site on a temporary basis: the entire space is available to everyone; each one will be responsible for taking care of the space, preventing the activities carried out from disturbing the neighbors; All activities are free; Each neighbor makes a portion of his time available to the others to develop and keep the project alive.Deliberations, Decisions and Public InteractionWe have one day to plan the strategy to follow and get materials and another two to clean and adapt the space until it is equipped with all the infrastructure that the neighbors requested. We built a vegetable garden, a sports area (soccer field, petanque and badminton), a market (barter and time bank) and an open-air theater. And, as in any park worth its salt, trails, green areas and rest areas, thanks to the trees and plants that already grew on the site. All this is handcrafted, with temporary and removable structures, trying to use the material found on the site, recycling and managing altruistic donations. The workshop concluded with the opening event of “Esta Es Una Plaza” on Friday, December 5, which was attended by not only neighbors, but also citizens interested in the possibility of continuing with similar projects in other places. There was fun for everyone, the children were finally able to play outdoors, without stepping on concrete, simultaneous games were organized in which the ages were mixed, there was spontaneous participation in the planting of the orchard, tasting of homemade food, musical and theater performances , projection of drawings made live on the walls, silent music and, above all, a lot of communication between the attendees. Due to this great neighborhood enthusiasm, the group "Operarios del Espacio Público" has decided to develop this experimental project for the care and self-management of the urban site of C / Doctor Fourquet no 24. Influence, Results and Effects The project consists of drawing up a non-profit temporary neighborhood self-management plan for the urban plot of C / Doctor Fourquet no 24. It is made up of six interrelated areas.Ecology: Orchard and GardensCommunity garden experimental project; cultivation is based on the self-organization of work among the inhabitants of the neighborhood. Seasonal vegetables will be grown without pesticides or chemical fertilizers. Gardens for the use and enjoyment of all neighbors, with rest and leisure areas. The gardens will be created taking advantage of the trees and plants already existing on the site, trying to alter the plant structure present as little as possible.Culture: Theater, Art GalleryThe theater will be used for plays, readings, improvisations, juggling ... The theater activities will be free and for everyone. The Art Gallery is open to all artists who wish to exhibit their works temporarily.sportsFootball, boules, badminton, games for children - with the only rule not to play alone.Barter: Exchange of Time and ObjectsAn area covered with tables and benches for discussions, meetings, meals and snacks in common, as well as for the exchange of time, skills, objects ...Infrastructuremaintenance of the installationsCommunicationmaintenance of the blog and email accounts, installation of a postal mailbox at the front door to encourage citizen participation.
